[IDAT.4.6.2] **`ds_slot_kind_t` is the runtime tag, not the
schema-declared type.** The two are separate enums ([IDAT.5.3]), and
[NFCT.2.3]'s table pairs them. A `Time`, `Date` or `Duration` slot carries
`DS_SLOT_INT`. A `Json` slot carries `DS_SLOT_JSON`, whatever its tree holds:
a node inside the tree has a `ds_json_kind_t`, which is not a slot kind. A null
value, in a slot declared `T?` ([LNUL.3.1]), carries `DS_SLOT_NULL`, and a
`Json` value whose root is `null` is that null ([LNUL.3.4]).
